episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Lee Gon mourns the tragic death of his father. Lee Lim goes on the run - and finds escape when he comes across a door to a parallel universe.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Gon insists he's an emperor from another world. An incredulous Jeong Tae-eul takes him to the police station, where he sees a familiar face.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Though Tae-eul finds Gon's story difficult to believe, some things about him are completely inexplicable. At work, she gets busy with a murder case.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: When Tae-eul loses her police badge, she can't help but think about Gon. Meanwhile, Kang Sin-jae has had it with his mother's bad habits.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Being introduced to Gon's world is a lot to process for Tae-eul, who's taken to the palace. A disgruntled Jo Yeong keeps an eye on her.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: A potential military conflict theatens the kingdom. Gon promises Tae-eul he will return to her, and steps forward to take care of the situation.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Gon brings Yeong along on his trip back to Tae-eul. He has a favor to ask of her, while she's found something troubling to share with him.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: In Corea, Luna is set free. In Korea, Gon and Yeong run into a man who recognizes them, and Sin-jae experiences childhoos flashbacks.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Gon draws closer to tracking down Lim, and asks Jo Eun-sup to trade places with Yeong. Mail from an unknown sender bothers Koo Seo-ryeong.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: On Lunar New Year, Gon and Lim come face-to-face in a public standoff. Tae-eul opens up to Sin-jae about the other world and her ongoing case.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: A compelling offer finds its way to Luna. Gon's investigation into a devastating murder leads him to an old traitor and a clearer idea of Lim's schemes.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Frightening circumstances land Tae-eul back in Gon's arms. When Yeong runs into a woman who looks strikingly familiar, he follows her.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: Knowing Seo-ryeong is up to no good, Gon throws her in a tight spot. Upon returning to her wordl, Tae-eul realizes Luna is there, too.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: Gon and Tae-eul are separated when he sets out to fulfill what's been his fate all along. Sin-jae makes a startling discovery.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.summary: Lims plots his next meeting with Gon. Understanding there's only one thing he can do to right wrongs, Gon comes to a heart-wrenching decision.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.summary: A final attempt to put a stop to Lim's ambitions comes with profound consequences. Gon travels far and wide in search of Tae-eul.
